items.q: we did theater dates with Jimmy Durante. For about three or four months.

ctx.x: And we played Blue Gardens and we did Mildred joined us and we did theater dates with Jimmy Durante. For about three or four months.
Because I remember that -- some of the things that Mildred was singing, out at -- Alec Wilder had done the arrangements. So was that the time?
